# Contact and data protection

## Contact
Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9:00-17:00 CET, by email at support@demo-store.example.com. We answer within 24 hours on working days.
We do not offer a phone hotline.

## Data protection
We store customer data on servers in the European Union. Chat conversations are deleted automatically after 90 days.
You can ask us to delete your data at any time by writing to support. We delete chat history linked to your email address within 30 days.
